requirements.requirement: The system must map provider score responses from EVAL-SCORE-PROV into the frontend explainability schema defined in EVAL-EXPLAIN-UX-S1.
The system must map clinical trial score responses from EVAL-SCORE-CT into the frontend explainability schema defined in EVAL-EXPLAIN-UX-S1.
The system must map explainability breakdown data from EVAL-EXPLAIN into measures, weights, and contributions in the frontend schema.
The system must normalize differing backend field names into consistent frontend schema keys.
The system must construct a single unified explainability payload combining score and breakdown data when both are available.
The system must preserve numeric precision of scores, weights, and contributions during mapping.
The system must handle missing measure lists by returning an empty array in the frontend schema.
The system must handle missing contribution values by defaulting them to null without breaking the schema.
The system must omit invalid or non-numeric measure values from the mapped output.
The system must ensure that the mapped payload conforms to the TypeScript interface defined in EVAL-EXPLAIN-UX-S1.
The system must gracefully handle partial backend responses by populating available fields without throwing runtime errors.
The system must return a minimal valid explainability payload when only overall score data is available.
The system must return a minimal valid explainability payload when only breakdown data is available.
The system must log mapping errors for malformed backend responses without interrupting frontend rendering.
The system must ensure deterministic mapping such that identical backend inputs produce identical frontend outputs.
